## Elali (CR 4)

**XP** 1,200  
NG Medium humanoid (elali)  
**Init** +7; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +7  

**Defense**

 **AC** 20, touch 13, flat-footed 17 (+3 armor, +3 Dex, +4 natural)  
**hp** 37 (5d8+15)  
**Fort** +3, **Ref** +4, **Will** +7; +2 versus mind-affecting effects  
**Immune** paralysis; **Resist** electricity 10, fire 10; **SR** 15  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** +2 dagger +8 (1d4+1/19–20)  
**Special Attacks** mental paralysis (DC 15)  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 4th; concentration +7)  
At will—levitate (self only)  
3/day—disguise self (humanoid only), suggestion (DC 15), vocal alteration  
1/day—shield, modify memory (DC 17), vanish  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 9, **Dex** 16, **Con** 15, **Int** 18, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 16  
**Base Atk** +3; **CMB** +2; **CMD** 15  
**Feats** Improved Initiative, Toughness, Weapon Finesse  
**Skills** Diplomacy +7, Heal +9, Knowledge (arcana) +7, Knowledge (planes) +7, Perception +7, Sense Motive +10, Spellcraft +8, Stealth +5, Use Magic Device +10; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Sense Motive, +4 Use Magic Device  
**Languages** Celestial, Common, Elali, Ultari; telepathy 100 ft.  
**SQ** psychic enhancement +2  

**Ecology**

 **Environment** any land  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or cluster (3–12)  
**Treasure** NPC gear (omniweave armor, dagger, other gear)
